Title: COPY command now generally available in Azure Synapse Analytics

Body.Content:
The COPY command feature in Azure Synapse Analytics provides users a simple, flexible, and fast interface for high-throughput data ingestion for SQL workloads. WIth this announcement, we've added performance improvements with file splits, ease of use with Parquet auto-schema discovery and complex data type support, and the support of the COPY command within our data integration partner ecosystem including: Databricks, Informatica, Streamsets, Panoply, and Talend.

Learn More
